FluorescentCells.tif

This image is made from a Molecular Probes demo slide:

   Cells: bovine pulmonary arthery endothelial cells
   Blue: nucleus stained with DAPI
   Green: Tubulin stained with Bodipy FL goat anti-mouse IgG
   Red: F-Actin stained with Texas Red X-Phalloidin
   
ImageJ opens it as a 3 channel, 8-bit composite image. Use
the slider under the image to switch channels. The subtitle
has information about the current channel. For example,
"2/3 (Green)" indicates that the current channel is the 2nd of 3
and its label is "Green". Open the "Channels" tool by pressing
shift-z (Image>HyperStacks>Channels) and you will be able to
enable/disable channels or view individual channels. Use the
"B&C" tool (Image>Adjust>Brightness/Contrast) to adjust the
brightness and contrast of the current channel. Change the color
of the current channel by selecting a different LUT from the
Image>Lookup Tables menu. Convert to RGB using the 
Image>Color>Stack to RGB command.
